subject: Fix corpse-walk and START-deferral action_state clusters (27)
description:
DONE at cc3737b28 on wt-fix-corpsewalk. Root cause for both (a) and (b) was one bug, and it was not the START-deferral hypothesis: the ordinary (non-TillLastFrame) motion path commits its step and only then evaluates IsGoalReached, returning TERMINATED whatever the sprite was about to report. Rust stood in a straight-line `dist <= speed` prediction. That is wrong twice over — the predicate is a tolerance-compared dot product against the movement increment, and anti-collision deviates the step and rebuilds the increment before the predicate reads it, so a walker sidestepping a neighbour covers more ground than remains and still does not arrive. Fix: new `projected_step_reaches_goal` in engine/movement.rs projects the step on a throwaway PositionInterface copy (anti-collision + deviation + increment rebuild), and `movement_execute_visible_motion` now returns Terminated on arrival from Start/InProgress/Done alike. The fast-climb arm's near-identical inline projection was folded into the same helper and gains the increment rebuild it lacked (unvalidated path — worth watching climb traces in the sweep). Also gated the deferred-PC and transition-distance postponed START effects on state_effect_motion==Start, matching the ordinary one.

Validated in debug: 6 traces now run to exact EOF (Nescafe/P001/S015 r007 f249, linux3/P001/S031 r002 f1408 and r003 f1509, Nescafe/P002/S000 r012 f1368, linux3/P002/Continue r007 f618, nicouzouf/S036 r006 f601); corpse repro linux3/P003/S007 r008 advances f4362 -> f4524 (unrelated soldier animation); nicouzouf/S031 r002 advances f917 -> f1021. 4 short controls from the `pass` set unchanged. No new unit-test failures (the 4 red movement tests are red on the pristine baseline too); added `committed_step_arrival_outranks_every_sprite_result`.

Remaining, split out rather than chased: nicouzouf/S069 r005 still diverges at f457 — same "rust missing Moving" signature but a different mechanism (order_tolerance 21.0 tolerance arrival plus StrangleCmd post-seek handoff resetting the state), not the committed-step predicate. Item (c) WalkingWithShield is still untouched: C++ stamps MovingShield every tick and HoldingShield on TERMINATED, Rust stamps nothing, and no trace in the corpus isolates it — the TODO stays in docs/ACTION_STATE_ARMS.md.
